title: Cohen: serious ethical commitment and legal relief
shortTitle: Cohen: serious ethical commitment and legal relief
summary: The book returns to Cohen for a different doctrinal purpose.
notes: The earlier opinion helps frame intention to be legally bound, while the later opinion sustains promissory-estoppel compensation. The notes question whether the source and reporters could have made a bargain and whether an ethically serious promise can reasonably induce reliance. Distinguish the court’s characterization from the reader’s invited criticism of it.
